facts.text: Designed by Kengo Kuma with the vision of Ian Schrager.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Kengo Kuma with the vision of Ian Schrager, all 206 guest rooms at The Tokyo EDITION, Toranomon offer breathtaking glimpse of Tokyo skyline

facts.text: Guest rooms offer views of Tokyo Tower and Tokyo Bay.
facts.excerpt: offer breathtaking glimpse of Tokyo skyline including views of Tokyo Tower and Tokyo Bay

facts.text: The hotel has accommodation with private terraces starting from level 31.
facts.excerpt: the first-of-its-kind accommodation with private terraces starting from level 31

facts.text: The Jade Room + Garden Terrace is the hotel's signature restaurant, a modern Wagyu steakhouse.
facts.excerpt: The Jade Room + Garden Terrace, the hotel’s signature restaurant, offers a modern Wagyu steakhouse experience celebrating Japan’s finest Wagyu beef

facts.text: The Jade Room + Garden Terrace has views of Tokyo Tower and the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: sweeping views of Tokyo Tower and the city skyline

facts.text: The Garden Terrace is open seasonally and sits 140 meters above the city.
facts.excerpt: Open seasonally and perched 140 meters above the city, the Garden Terrace offers a serene open-air escape from the pace of city life

facts.text: Gold Bar at EDITION is a cocktail bar on the ground floor next to the hotel entrance.
facts.excerpt: Nestled next to the hotel entrance on the ground floor, Gold Bar at EDITION

facts.text: Gold Bar at EDITION takes classic cocktails such as the Martini, Daiquiri and Manhattan further, using modern techniques and local Japanese flavors.
facts.excerpt: Gold Bar takes classic cocktails such as the Martini, Daiquiri, and Manhattan to contemporary, sophisticated levels, incorporating modern techniques and local Japanese flavors.

facts.text: The Lobby Bar overlooks Tokyo Bay and Tokyo Tower and offers an afternoon tea service.
facts.excerpt: a unique afternoon tea service in an open yet intimate environment overlooking Tokyo Bay and the Tokyo Tower

facts.text: The Blue Room serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, with plant-based salads, local market fish and grilled meats.
facts.excerpt: breakfast, lunch or dinner throughout the day. This chic space serves a menu inspired by international all-time classics including a variety of plant-based signature salads, light protein options, local market fish, grilled meats and sharing platters.

facts.text: The spa uses products organically sourced and made in Japan.
facts.excerpt: using only products organically sourced, and proudly made in Japan

facts.text: The gym is powered by Technogym and open 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: The 24-hour Gym is powered by Technogym

facts.text: The pool area is designed like a conservatory with high windows for natural light.
facts.excerpt: The private pool area is designed like a conservatory with high windows to bathe the area in natural light.

facts.text: Pool use requires advance reservation.
facts.excerpt: Reservations are required in advance.

facts.text: The pool is open to children 4 years old and above, and children under 15 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
facts.excerpt: The pool is open to children 4 years old and above; however, children under 15 years old must be accompanied by a parent or guardian at all times for safety reasons.

facts.text: The hotel is near the Kamiyacho, Roppongi-Itchome and Toranomon subway stations.
facts.excerpt: Conveniently located near the subway stations of Kamiyacho, Roppongi-Itchome and Toranomon

facts.text: Custom-built EDITION bikes by tokyobike are available for complimentary hire.
facts.excerpt: Custom-built EDITION bikes by tokyobike for complimentary hire to explore the city

facts.text: Pets are not allowed and the property is smoke free.
facts.excerpt:
Smoke free property
- Pets not allowed

facts.text: Mobility accessible rooms are available for certain room types.
facts.excerpt: Mobility accessible rooms available for certain room types

facts.text: The hotel can arrange a private car to and from Narita and Haneda airports through the concierge.
facts.excerpt: a private car to/from Tokyo Narita International Airport (NRT) can be arranged by the hotel concierge prior to your arrival/departure
